column1: # gpu-qp benchmark run matrix: one row per phase/lane/cell group. lane.sh expands a row into
# cells (molecules outer, seeds inner) and lanes.py reads this file; state lives in
#   extra_args  space-separated solver tokens, `-` for none
#   seeds       comma list; molecules: comma list of indices 0-5 (H2 HeH+ LiH BeH2 H2O NH3)
#   step        lanes sharing a step run concurrently; steps run ascending
# A (phase, lane) may have several rows; its cells are the rows' cells in row order. Exceptions
# are rows: NH3 to convergence costs 5-8 h per cell on the Aer lanes, so A2 runs it with one seed.
# The Aer lanes estimate gradients by finite differences (one optimiser step costs n_params+1
# evaluations), so a fixed evaluation budget starves them; only the conv: phases converge.
# The columns are frozen: later changes add rows and code, not columns.
